subject: pe
title: Joint Axes and Planes
welcome_lead: Sagittal, frontal, transverse — describe every movement with three axes.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on planes and axes of body movement.
final_note: Three planes, three axes — the coordinate system of human motion.

concepts.def: Side-to-side axis around which sagittal-plane movements occur.
Front-back axis around which frontal-plane movements occur.
Vertical axis around which transverse-plane movements occur.

walkthroughs.body_html: Each plane has a perpendicular axis. Flexion in sagittal plane occurs around the frontal axis.
A leg side-kick: frontal plane, sagittal axis. A pirouette: transverse plane, longitudinal axis.
Coaches use plane/axis language to clarify rehab and drill specifications.
